analysis.overview: A production-quality, high-performance Fruit Ninja-inspired game built using HTML5 Canvas, Phaser 3, and MediaPipe Hands. On the main menu, click or hover over the CAM: OFF button in the top-right. Key features include Mirrored Floating Viewport, Interactive Watermelon Start, Zero Asset Dependency, How to Play, Camera Controls Hands-Free, and Mouse & Touch Controls.
